title: Block Technology Manager (BTM), Assistant Technology Manager (ATM)
qualification: BTM: Post Graduate in Agriculture/Allied sector with computer skills; ATM: Graduate in Agriculture/Allied Sector
salary: The notice gives the remuneration per month only and does not mention any allowance or the in-hand salary.
age_limit: The maximum age limit for candidates shall be as per State Government Rules / Policy. The notice does not print the age in years, a cut-off date for age or the category-wise relaxations.
application_fee: The notice calls it a processing fee. The link for submission of the online application fee will be available on the official website of the Department of Agriculture, Government of Manipur, and the fee is submitted with the online application within the stipulated period.
selection_process: Shortlisting for interview on the basis of the Academic Performance Indicator (API) score, in the ratio of 3:1 to the number of posts. || Interview. || There will be no written examination. The API score calculator is provided on the Department website.

title: Constable, SI, ASI, Havildar, Riflemen, LDC, Nurse, Follower and Others
qualification: Constable, SI and other posts – 2698 Posts
salary: The salary structure varies according to the post. The notification specifies pay levels under the Revised Pay Rules (ROP) 2019 but does not provide individual monthly basic-pay amounts in rupees.
age_limit: Candidates whose applications were previously submitted and duly sponsored by the concerned Employment Exchange under the specified earlier notifications do not need to apply afresh. Such candidates will also receive a one-time relaxation in the upper age limit. || This provision applies to eligible applicants under the earlier recruitment notifications dated 14 July 2021, 17 October 2022 and 13 March 2024, as identified in the new notification.
application_fee: Manipur Police has prescribed a fee of Rs. 400 per application form . Eligible Persons with Disabilities candidates are exempted from paying the application fee. || The forms are available from the offices of the concerned District Superintendents of Police during office hours.
selection_process: The notification mentions a Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Written Test as part of the recruitment process. Their dates and times will be announced separately by the department. || Detailed post-wise test patterns, qualifying standards, marks and any additional selection stages have not been specified in the uploaded notification. Candidates should follow further official announcements for complete selection procedures.
